title: research-graph-route Configuration
description: ADR-045 route_search: structured-emit routing decision over upstream ClassifierOutput. Emits one of synthesize_directly / retighten / walk_seeds / decompose for R2 dispatch.

loops_bucket.description: NATS KV bucket holding research-pipeline loops and trigger/completion keys

max_candidates_in_prompt.description: Cap on number of ClassifierOutput candidates embedded in the router prompt. Top-N by relevance; tighter caps keep prompts within small-model context windows. 0 means default (10)

max_response_tokens.description: Cap on LLM response tokens. The JSON-shaped output is small; 512 covers the worst case across the four action shapes

ports.description: Port configuration. route_search requires one nats input subscribing to component.route_search.>
